scope.external_materials: retain native TCon stats and tooltips; no inferred affinity is claimed

evidence.ambrosium: solar_powered trait restores performance in light; ranged-only construction supplies no forceful head
evidence.cloggrum: solid trait, armor support, positive durability, and deliberately slower handling
evidence.echo_wood: woodwind trait, +accuracy and +speed, paired with low durability
evidence.forgotten: severing trait, 3.3 head attack, netherite-tier durability, and slower handling
evidence.froststeel: freezing trait, armor toughness, positive accuracy, and slower handling
evidence.gravitite: knockback trait, 3.2 head attack, mobility fantasy, and explicit accuracy penalty
evidence.holystone: stoneshield trait, mining-speed support, and slower handling
evidence.regalium: preserved trait supplies conservation and deliberate handling rather than raw protection
evidence.reinforced_echo: reinforced trait supplies strong durability/conservation at a cadence cost
evidence.resonarium: attractive trait, +melee speed, +draw speed, +accuracy, and reduced durability
evidence.sculk_bone: necrotic trait supplies renewal, melee support, and reduced durability
evidence.skyroot: lightweight trait, +melee/draw/mining speed, mobility fantasy, and low durability
evidence.utherium: dwarven trait, +mining speed, +handling speed, and no conservation bonus
evidence.warden_carapace: stalwart trait, top durability/toughness/knockback resistance, and slower handling
evidence.zanite: invariant trait, +accuracy and +mining speed, with no resource-conservation behavior
